verdict.rationale: Serverless, scale-to-zero GPU workers are a fair question for a GPU cloud, so this axis applies. The evidence only documents always-on GPU VMs (On-Demand Cloud), 1-Click Clusters, Managed Kubernetes and Managed Slurm, all billed while running. Nothing describes serverless endpoints, request-driven autoscaling or scale-to-zero, and a community report notes that Lambda bills running instances whether idle or in use, which is the always-on model the story wants to avoid.
